name: issue_dashboard
title: Issue / Costing Dashboard (store issues by plant, department, cost centre, equipment, item)
description: Store / material issue value from VIEW_ISSUE_ENGINE_PBI - exact logic of 'Issue_Dashboard_v3.html' (Costing Intelligence). Use for: '/issue_dashboard', 'issue report', 'store issue', 'material issue', 'issue value', 'costing', 'consumption by plant / department / cost centre / equipment', 'top issued items'.
rules:
SOURCE
1. Data: VIEW_ISSUE_ENGINE_PBI (one row per issue line: VRDATE, VRNO, DEPT_NAME, PLANT_NAME, DIV_CODE, ITEM_GROUP, COST_NAME, EQPT_NAME, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, UM, QTY_ISSUED, RATE, VAL_ISSUED).
2. ALWAYS use run_report_engine(skill_name='issue_dashboard', from_date, to_date). Never write SQL for this report.
3. Period = issue date (VRDATE). Default = this month so far. 'yesterday' = from_date = to_date = yesterday.
4. Value = VAL_ISSUED, shown in Rs Lakh. Compared with the same days of the previous month.
5. Division (U1/U2 from DIV_CODE) and the user's plant list (PLANT_NAME) are applied by the engine on the server - never mention other plants.
OUTPUT
KPI cards, plant / department / item group / cost centre / equipment tables, top 25 items, and the Issue dashboard (slicers, breakdowns, rate analysis, matrix, data, Excel export).
output_format: Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers KPI cards (issue value Rs Lakh vs previous period, lines, vouchers, items, top plant, top department), the tables and the live dashboard by itself. Reply with a 2-3 line summary: total value, biggest plant and department, biggest change.
example_output: KPI cards: Issue value 412.35 Rs Lakh (vs Sep 398.10) | Lines 8,214 | Vouchers 1,902 | Items 2,311 | Top plant SMLS PIPE 98.4 L | Top department MAINTENANCE 61.2 L. Then plant / department / item group / cost centre / equipment tables, top 25 items and the dashboard.
